steps.note: 5 jobs, deadlines up to 3. Take the richest first: d2:£100, d2:£27, d1:£25, d1:£19, d3:£15. Each goes in the latest free slot on or before its deadline.
Job d2:£100 — latest free slot by its deadline is slot 2. Schedule it there (+£100).
Job d2:£27 — latest free slot by its deadline is slot 1. Schedule it there (+£27).
Job d1:£25 — every slot up to deadline 1 is taken. It misses out.
Job d1:£19 — every slot up to deadline 1 is taken. It misses out.
Job d3:£15 — latest free slot by its deadline is slot 3. Schedule it there (+£15).
Total profit £142 from 3 jobs. Placing each as late as its deadline allows is what leaves room for the rest.
